offer.title: Add Reframe to the application menu?
offer.text: Reframe runs from the AppImage file {file}. An entry in the application menu starts it from there, shows the queue's progress on its taskbar button and lets the file manager open video files with it.
offer.later: You can add or remove it later in Settings → Application menu.
offer.failed: The entry could not be added: {reason}

settings.title: Application menu
settings.help: An entry for the AppImage file {file}: it gives taskbar progress and Open with in the file manager. If you move the file, start it once from its new folder and the entry follows it.
settings.other: The application menu already has an entry for Reframe ({path}), so this AppImage adds none.
settings.failed: The entry could not be changed: {reason}
